description: User approved incremental Repo-free Channels boundary for the email settings slice, not full node isolation. Engine owns email connector snapshots, writes, SMTP binding/default validation, encrypted persistence and current BO authorization; existing ChannelConfig schema remains in place. Move SaveEmailConnector preserving Zoi contracts. Engine sends exact saved connector runtime config through confidential NodeRouter event; Channels applies supplied configuration without Repo or BO actor DB resolution. Extend existing sync_provider_runtime operation's supplied-config form, retaining legacy provider-only paths outside scope. Use existing EmailBridge.sync_provider_runtime callback so enabled IMAP edits restart listener. Post-save dispatch/runtime failure remains saved/pending. Preserve prior staged/user work and typing fix. Planned child steps Engine operation/BO move, Repo-free runtime seam/integration/tests/docs. No commit/push authorization.
title: Move email settings persistence to Engine for isolated Channels
